name: Love★Distance ~Yokisenu Unmei~
original_name: ラブ★ディスタンス～予期せぬ運命～
source:
"Was that meeting part of my destiny?"

A young and egoistic actor who's at the height of his popularity fancies you...
A playboy who helped you in a tight spot just got serious about you...
A selfish lookalike of your ex-boyfriend is already making moves on you...
The choice is all yours! What destiny will you choose?

[Translated from [url=http://www.andamul.com/special/lovedis.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
“那次相遇是我命运的一部分吗？”

一位年轻而自私的演员，在他的人气鼎盛时期喜欢你……
一个在困境中帮助过你的花花公子现在却认真对待你了……
一个自私的、酷似你前男友的人已经开始对你采取行动了……
选择权都在你手中！你会选择怎样的命运？

[翻译自[url=http://www.andamul.com/special/lovedis.html]官网[/url]]
